about: Every miss of the first run (results/first.json, the frozen scanner), by cause. Read after that run, by the scanner's author. No label was changed.

A.cause: os.environ['AIRFLOW_HOME'] has no default, so the project path is unknown, though its tail names the project

B.cause: a helper imported from another workspace file builds the operator

C.cause: a container path that matches no project by its tail, where a mount names the host folder

D.cause: repo-local subclasses of operators, and factories driven by YAML

E.cause: cd ${AIRFLOW_HOME} with several projects in the workspace; a setup script says which

F.cause: a shell variable after a selector: a rule added before the freeze, without seeing this corpus, that was too strict here

G.reported_as: nothing at the frozen commit; an unknown since 64ce438
G.cause: a pod whose dbt command is in its image (4), and cmds=['/bin/bash','-cx'], which is not recognised as a shell (3)

H.reported_as: nothing at the frozen commit; an unknown since 64ce438
H.cause: a factory from a library. Expected unknown: nothing could tell, but it must be said

I.reported_as: one unknown at the call site, one wrong identity
I.cause: a date in an f-string makes the whole command unknown; a task with no dag= takes its DAG from the task before it

J.cause: the stand-in manifest counted a relationships test with enabled: false. A real manifest leaves it out

out_of_reach_of_a_scanner_of_dag_files.why: The answer is outside the DAG files: an image's entrypoint (eu-data-platform 3, kind-data-platform 1), a setup script (feast-workshop 4), a YAML config (dop 4). A person can follow these, so they stay misses. They are listed so the rate is not read as all reachable.
